product_brief: Defines a post-quantum public key algorithm extension for the OpenPGP protocol, extending RFC9580.
pqc_capability_description: Defines composite public key encryption based on ML-KEM (formerly CRYSTALS-Kyber) and composite public key signatures based on ML-DSA (formerly CRYSTALS-Dilithium), both in combination with elliptic curve cryptography, and SLH-DSA (formerly SPHINCS+) as a standalone public key signature scheme.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, ECDH, EdDSA, X25519, X448, Ed25519, Ed448
pqc_roadmap_details: Defines composite public key encryption based on ML-KEM and composite public key signatures based on ML-DSA, both in combination with elliptic curve cryptography, and SLH-DSA as a standalone public key signature scheme.
testing_&_validation_methods: Test vectors provided in Appendix A.

product_brief: Email encryption and collaboration platform part of Microsoft's quantum-safe transition strategy.
pqc_capability_description: PQC integration is planned for Microsoft 365 as part of Phase 3 ("All services and endpoints"). Foundational components like SymCrypt support ML-KEM and ML-DSA, available to Windows Insiders and Linux. Microsoft aims to enable early adoption by 2029 and complete transition by 2033.
crypto_primitives: RSA, ECDSA, AES, ML-KEM, ML-DSA, FrodoKEM
target_industries: Enterprise, Government, Financial services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, Automotive, Education
regulatory_status: Aligned with US government requirements (OMB, CISA, NIST, NSA/CNSA 2.0) and international initiatives (EU, Japan, Canada, Australia, UK).
pqc_roadmap_details: Early adoption by 2029; gradual default enablement in subsequent years; complete transition of services and products by 2033. Uses hybrid approach (classical + PQC) as interim step.
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: Enterprise-wide inventory conducted to assess and prioritize cryptographic asset risks.
testing_&_validation_methods: Microsoft Research completed testing of experimental PQC-protected VPN tunnel in 2019. SymCrypt supports verified PQC algorithms.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Microsoft addresses supply chain and ecosystem risks; partnered with industry leaders to address critical dependencies.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Multiyear transformation requiring immediate planning; phased transition strategy (Foundational, Core Infrastructure, All Services); hybrid approach used as interim step.
organizational_readiness: Requires immediate planning and coordinated execution; Microsoft provides tools and guidance for customers to start developing strategy.
